papers.title: Building robust machine learning models for small chemical science data: the case of shear viscosity of fluids
papers.actual_read_version: arXiv2208.10784v1, 23 August2022; preprint title omits final words of fluids
papers.read_depth: Selected sectionsII.2,III.1–III.3,IV.1–IV.3 including split procedures, metrics, qualitative interpolation and applicability domain; not full17page main/55pageSI reading.
papers.license: ActualarXivversion has perpetualnonexclusive distributionlicense. VORCCBY4.0 displayed in indexedPDF; fullVOR not retrieved, so do not transfer VORlicense to actualdownload.
papers.takeaway: Small-data model selection and performance estimation are distinct. Repeated use can overfit even carefulCV. Physical interpolation checks and multiple metrics supplement aggregate errors.
papers.project_decision: A predeclared multi-basis study should retain original formulation-level folds and all masks/metrics; label it retrospective development, not new independent materials.
papers.closest_difference: Their MD scalarLennard-Jones viscosity regression from thermodynamic/compositional descriptors is not six-anchor hydrogel curve continuation with a full GP residual.
papers.do_not_import: No independent formulations are created by random splits; their 2percent error criterion and MDphysicaldomain are not hydrogel tolerances.

papers.title: A prediction rigidity formalism for low-cost uncertainties in trained neural networks
papers.read_depth: Selected theory3.2–3.5 (quadraticloss, Hessian, Gaussianvariance, last-layerapproximation), calibration aroundeq25, OOD4.5, discussion5; not full25pages.
papers.license: ActualarXivversion perpetualnonexclusive distributionlicense. No wider redistribution permission assumed.
papers.takeaway: Quadratic loss rigidity, Gaussian uncertainty and efficient low-dimensional/last-layer covariance already have explicit precedent. Scale calibration remains necessary and representation-dependent.
papers.project_decision: Retain mathematical equivalences openly; novelty must be the hydrogel task/adaptation and controlled evidence. Do not rebrand a quadratic potential as a new probabilistic mechanism.
papers.closest_difference: They infer posthoc uncertainty for pretrained scalar regressors; our shared low-dimensional Gaussian correction changes a complete functional GP law and exact conditioning across masks.
papers.do_not_import: A reported OOD success on another dataset is no hydrogel guarantee; their last-layer assumptions do not establish our reliability.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification by direct propagation of shallow ensembles
papers.read_depth: SelectedII.1–II.5 architecture, scores, calibration and correlatedpropagation; III.1 comparator context; IV.6 OOD and conclusion context, not wholepaper/appendices.
papers.license: ActualarXivHTML states perpetualnonexclusive license; publisherisopenaccess but no downloadedVOR or externalcodeused. HTMLrenderdate not treated asversiondate.
papers.takeaway: Global calibration can hide local failures; correlated predictions must be propagated coherently. Their transferred surface example also underestimated true error before adding domain data.
papers.project_decision: Keep conditional CRPS, density, width/coverage and subgroup failures alongside full joint residual. Do not introduce posthoc scaling chosen on current external outcomes and call it confirmed calibration.
papers.closest_difference: Shallow neural ensemble propagation for atomistic and generic regression; not fixedcurvature correction for sparse hydrogel flow curves.
papers.do_not_import: No automatic calibration or OOD guarantee follows from coherent sampling or trainingNLL.
papers.code_use: Repository indexedREADME organization read only; no source imported or run; code license not inspected.

papers.title: Machine and deep learning performance in out-of-distribution regressions

papers.license: CCBY4.0 explicitPDFpage2. Keep authorattribution/journal/DOI ifredistributed; currenttaskkeepsPDFlocal.
papers.takeaway: A bounded representation intervention can be tested against an unchanged learner across explicit OOD definitions; interpolative and OOD behavior need separate reporting.
papers.project_decision: Use a fixed low-capacity representation comparison instead of unbounded architecture search. Retain all results and explain our one-sided-coordinate continuation versus material-source shift.
papers.closest_difference: Tabular symbolic-regression feature engineering across15datasets; our physically fixed contrasts, full residual and hydrogel-specific conditional task remain distinct.
papers.do_not_import: Their 50repetitions are not extra experimental units here. Their target-sparsity OOD definition is not a label-free deployment gate.
